decks.notes: This deck focuses on building a strong aggro strategy with the two partner commanders, Tana and Yoshimaru. The deck includes a mix of efficient creatures, removal spells, and combat tricks to quickly apply pressure to the opponent and overwhelm them. With a diverse mana base and access to powerful cards like Skullclamp, Swords to Plowshares, and Umezawa's Jitte, the deck aims to maintain board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan while steadily chipping away at their life total. By combining the aggressive nature of red and white with the ramp and versatility of green, the deck seeks to establish dominance on the battlefield and secure victory through swift and decisive attacks.

This deck focuses on utilizing Raffine, Scheming Seer as the commander to enable a fast and aggressive playstyle in a Duel Commander format. The deck includes a mix of low-cost creatures, disruptive spells, and protective cards to establish early board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a combination of efficient removal like Fatal Push and Swords to Plowshares, along with counterspells such as Force of Will and Spell Pierce, the deck aims to control the game tempo while deploying threats like True-Name Nemesis and Skyclave Apparition to apply pressure. Overall, the strategy revolves around quickly establishing a dominant board presence and leveraging Raffine's abilities to outpace the opponent and secure victory.

The main strategy of this deck revolves around utilizing a wide range of versatile control cards to disrupt the opponent's game plan while simultaneously ramping up to play powerful multicolored spells. Niv-Mizzet Reborn serves as the commander, providing card advantage and selection by allowing the player to draw ten cards and keep any multicolored cards among them. The deck includes a mix of removal spells, counter magic, and efficient creatures to control the board and outvalue the opponent. The mana base consists of a variety of lands to ensure consistent access to multiple colors of mana to cast the wide array of spells in the deck.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board while deploying Raffine, Scheming Seer to generate card advantage and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It utilizes a mix of countermagic, removal spells, and disruptive creatures to keep the opponent off balance. The deck also includes a range of powerful creatures and planeswalkers to apply pressure and close out the game quickly once the opponent's resources have been depleted. Raffine's ability to scry and manipulate the top of the library allows the deck to consistently draw into its powerful spells and land drops, ensuring a smooth and efficient game plan.

The deck revolves around using Atraxa, Grand Unifier as the commander to control the game through a combination of strong removal spells, counterspells, and powerful planeswalkers. The key strategy is to disrupt opponents' plans while slowly gaining advantage on the board with powerful cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Jace, the Mind Sculptor. The deck also includes strong ramp spells like Utopia Sprawl and Three Visits to ensure consistent mana development. With a focus on controlling the game and out-valuing opponents, the deck aims to draw out the game and grind out victories through attrition and resource advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing small, aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal damage efficiently. It includes a mix of low-cost creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, along with powerful burn spells such as Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning. The commander, Ghyrson Starn, Kelermorph, adds an extra layer of aggression and synergy to the deck. The strategy is to establish early board presence, chip away at the opponent's life total with direct damage spells, and finish them off with a swift assault. The deck aims to be fast-paced and relentless, putting pressure on the opponent from the start and maintaining it until the game is won.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Counterspell, and Fatal Push, the deck aims to prevent the opponent from establishing a board presence while also efficiently dealing with any threats that do make it onto the battlefield. Additionally, with cards like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Snapcaster Mage, the deck has access to powerful card advantage and selection to ensure that it can maintain control throughout the game. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and provide flexibility in casting its spells.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies using the partner commanders Tana, the Bloodsower and Yoshimaru, Ever Faithful. The deck includes a wide range of creatures and spells to apply pressure on the opponent quickly and efficiently. With a mix of fast creatures, removal spells, and combat tricks, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent and win the game as quickly as possible. By using the powerful abilities of the commanders and the versatility of the cards in the deck, the player aims to establish early dominance on the battlefield and maintain momentum throughout the game to secure victory.
